resvg-wasm, vendored for the merch Worker's print fallback (docs/design/merch/PART4.md)

Files
  index_bg.wasm   @resvg/resvg-wasm 2.6.2, unchanged (sha-256 22bf6e9f9a100d972da0411a69c5ba504367fc1fa87b3b64e3f35e53926d2d70)
  resvg_glue.js   the package's index.mjs (sha-256 10170d02d816f02ec76f9bc095b01d9becf536e7b1e12e5aa616652c84b237a1), wrapped in one factory
                  function so each call makes a fresh wasm instance (see the comment at its top). The code inside is unchanged.

Source code
  The Source Code Form of both files is at https://github.com/yisibl/resvg-js/tree/v2.6.2 and in the npm package
  https://registry.npmjs.org/@resvg/resvg-wasm/-/resvg-wasm-2.6.2.tgz. Our one change (the factory wrapper in resvg_glue.js) is in this folder and
  stays under MPL-2.0. Nothing else of this project is under MPL-2.0: the rest of the Worker only calls these files.
